status: visual selections sealed before fitting or transform inspection
observer: AI technical image inspection; not human-expert, marker, infection, cell-type, or registration-accuracy evidence

coordinates.he_rotated_xy: Displayed H&E panel after its already-plotted 90-degree counterclockwise rotation; pixel x rightwards, y downwards, as labelled on paired-inspection.png. Not unrotated he-preview coordinates.
coordinates.if_xy: Displayed IF channel-0 preview pixel x rightwards, y downwards.
coordinates.uncertainty: Approximate subjective per-axis center uncertainty in each displayed image, not statistical confidence intervals.

excluded_information: Did not read crop plans, matrices, registration receipts, computed projections, fitting results, or other agents' proposed points before sealing these choices.
selection_protocol: Four fit and two held-out memberships fixed now. Held-out observations must not be used to fit or select the transformation. Do not tune these coordinates in response to residuals.

landmarks.description: Isolated oval opening close to the upper-right corner: pale/white in H&E and dark, with a bright rim in IF. Approximate interior center, not a boundary or cell identity.
Broad central pale opening in H&E and the central dark lobed opening enclosed by the conspicuous bright IF rim. The irregular interior makes its visual center imprecise.
Large vertically extended lower-right opening, below the diagonal central band: bright H&E interior and dark IF interior with bright bordering patches. Center of the broad lower lobe.
Narrow oblique opening in the bottom-right region, separated below the large lower-right lobe: white H&E slit and elongated dark IF gap. Approximate middle of the slit.

Upper-central rounded pocket at the left end of the curved pale H&E gap, beside the dark nuclei; corresponding dark rounded IF pocket at the left end of the curved upper gap. Smaller and less sharply bounded than the fit openings.

Small rounded pale pocket above-left of the broad central H&E opening; dark rounded pocket immediately left of the upper part of the bright central IF rim. Approximate interior center; local texture limits precision.

limitations: Coarse appearance-based correspondences of openings/gaps, not independently validated anatomic identities.
Centers of irregular spaces are not exact point features and may shift between modalities.
Only this small crop and channel-0 display were inspected; marker identity and infection status are unverified.
A failed or ambiguous held-out comparison must be reported rather than moving the points after fitting.
